title: Chapter 283: All-Out Attack
content:
Chapter 283: All-Out Attack

The Zerg destroyers no longer carry out blocking attacks. If the aliens want to send some troops to the urban areas occupied by the Zerg army to fight against the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, Wu Qing is very welcome.

The Zerg destroyers will attack all the alien armies within the range according to the real-time intelligence provided by the Zerg host, mainly to eliminate the living forces of the alien army.

Wu Qing actually has the resources to continue to increase the number of Zerg destroyers. If he saves a little resource consumption in other places, it will be no problem to add hundreds of thousands of one-star Zerg destroyers.

The purpose of not doing this is to keep the aliens in a protracted war.

The aliens are now keeping an eye on the Zerg destroyers in the Zerg army. The formulation of various strategies and tactics is to eliminate the Zerg destroyers as the primary goal.

If there are hundreds of thousands of Zerg destroyers in the Zerg army, the alien army will have no choice but to passively take the beating.

Faced with this situation, the aliens will either avoid the war directly or upgrade the level of the war, and various strong men will personally go into battle.

This is not in the interests of Wu Qing. What Wu Qing wants is to keep fighting with the alien race and consume the alien race's manpower.

In this way, while earning a lot of resources, it can reduce the pressure of other races in the local camp facing the alien race, and finally achieve a counterattack by the entire camp and completely defeat the alien race in this public battlefield.

As long as the Zerg can achieve this goal, the Zerg will have the opportunity to gain the status of a large tribe in the local camp.

Therefore, many times, even if you have strength, you can't use your full strength. If your strength has not reached the height of doing whatever you want, you have to be restricted in doing things.

Just like the alien race, they must have many powerful means to solve the problem of Zerg destroyers, but they are restricted by the rules of the battlefield and cannot be used easily.

Otherwise, it will cause greater trouble.

The super tribe is like this, let alone the Zerg at this time.

The current 150,000 Zerg destroyers in the Zerg army are just the right number. When they are fully output, the firepower is strong enough.

The situation where they need to slow down after fighting with all their strength just meets the expectations of the aliens, so that they will not feel that this battle cannot be fought.

If they really feel that the firepower is not enough, they can also solve it by upgrading the star level of the Zerg destroyer.

Sometimes high-quality output is more effective than large-scale output.

Using the resources of hatching hundreds of thousands of Zerg destroyers to upgrade the existing 150,000 Zerg destroyers will have a better effect on the combat effectiveness of the Zerg army.

In this way, the aliens will not be scared of the troops.

After being bombarded for a while, the alien army within the attack range of the Zerg destroyers retreated to the safe zone, some hid in the safer underground bunkers, and some were forced into the area of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

The new partners of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions once again fought with the alien army.

…

In other directions of the Tianwai Human City, the Zerg Puppies outside the city have all waited for the arrival of the Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion.

The ratio of the Zerg Puppies to the Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion is about ten to one. Ten Zerg Puppies can get the long-range support of one Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion.

On the walls of the Tianwai City, the Tianwai army is on full alert.

The proportion of the Tianwai army that is guarding against the Zerg Puppies is very small, and they are basically the armies of various affiliated races.

Even so, without the firepower support of the Zerg Destroyer, it is very difficult for the Zerg Puppies to attack the city.

Now that the Zerg Puppies have the long-range firepower support of their new partners, the difficulty of attacking the city has been reduced a lot.

If the Zerg Explosive Swarms hovering in the sky are added, the difficulty of attacking the city will be further reduced.

The focus of the defense of the Tianwai Human City 996 is in the direction of the main combat position of the Zerg. The Tianwai Humans did not take the encirclement of the Zerg Puppies to heart.

All the three types of Zerg poisonous ray scorpions were in place. At Wu Qing's command, tens of millions of Zerg puppies surrounded the huge Tianwai Human City 996 and launched an attack at the same time!

The Zerg explosive mosquitoes and Zerg queens that reinforced the Zerg's first sub-base flew from high altitude and avoided many eyes.

The spectators of various forces in the local camp and the Tianwai Human Army did not notice their arrival.

There are a lot of Zerg explosive mosquitoes coming this time. They are the strongest firepower support outside the attack range of the Zerg destroyers.

Wherever there is a need for firepower support, the Zerg explosive mosquitoes will go there.

As soon as the Zerg puppies moved, the long-range attack troops of the Tianwai Human Army defending on the city wall entered the battle position, and with a small number of siege weapons, they were ready to attack the Zerg puppies that were about to enter the range.

In the sky above the 996th city of the alien race, a large number of Zerg explosive mosquitoes of various star levels, under the unified command of the Zerg Queen, accelerated their dives towards the long-range troops and siege weapons of the alien army in the entire city wall area.

"Boom boom boom boom...!"

The violent explosion sounded throughout the 996th city of the alien race.

The long-range attack troops and siege weapons of the alien army distributed in various defense positions were all attacked by self-explosion to varying degrees.

These ordinary alien troops and siege weapons were not protected by energy shields. The self-detonation attack of the Zerg Explosive Swarm was amazing, and a large number of alien troops and siege weapons were fatally hit.

The Queen of Zerg observed the self-detonation attack effects of Zerg Explosive Swarms of different star levels to test various targets and determine which star level Zerg Explosive Swarms should be used to attack.

It would be a waste to use all five-star Zerg Explosive Swarms. If it is not an important target or a large number of troops are gathered, the killing effect of using five-star, four-star, or three-star Zerg Explosive Swarms for general targets is actually not much different.

Even one-star and two-star Zerg Explosive Swarms are enough to complete most of the attack tasks.

The spectators of various forces in the alien and local camps have always thought that all Zerg Explosive Swarms are five-star in strength.

They were shocked when they found so many Zerg Explosive Swarms launching attacks.

With such a large number of five-star Zerg Explosive Swarms attacking at the same time, the defense system of the entire alien 996 cities will be destroyed!

Fortunately, this is not the case. The star strength of most of the Zerg Blasting Swarms that attacked this time is not high. Some positions even have one-star Zerg Blasting Swarms that are self-destructing.

The attack power of these Zerg Blasting Swarms varies, but they effectively assist the attacks of Zerg Zerglings and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions.

With the support of Zerg Blasting Swarms, the long-range attack arms of the alien army were seriously affected, giving the Zerg Zerglings precious time to charge.

Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions, scattered among the Zerg Zerglings, continuously fired poisonous rays at the alien army within the range.

Their primary attack target is the long-range attack arms of the alien army. Their enhanced long-range attack capabilities are enough to support them to shoot at a high frequency within a certain period of time.

Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions are long-range attack arms, which pose the greatest threat, and will naturally be the focus of the alien army's attacks.

The Zerg Zerglings around them will pounce on them when they are attacked to resist damage for them.

Their bodies are shorter than Zerg Puppies, and only their upright tails are very high. With this body structure, even if Zerg Puppies are on them, it will not affect their tails from launching attacks.

If they are injured, they can choose to burrow underground to recover according to the injury, and then come out to fight after the injury is recovered.

Zerg Puppies are the consumption arms of Zerg, and Type III Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion is also considered as the consumption arms of Zerg, but when conditions permit, it is still preferred to consume Zerg Puppies. These long-range arms that consume gas resources should be consumed as little as possible.

The number of Type III Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion troops is relatively small, but it plays a very critical role. Their cooperation with Zerg Exploding Swarm allows a large number of Zerg Puppies to rush under the city wall despite the attack of the alien human army.

Zerg Puppies climbing the city wall is like walking on flat ground, without any impact. They climb up quickly along the city wall like spiders.

"Boom boom!"

The Zerg Explosive Mosquito launched a second large-scale self-destruction attack at the right time. The precise self-destruction attack adjusted by the Queen again helped the Zerg Puppies to attack the city wall at the critical moment.

The three types of Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions all launched attacks with all their strength to suppress the alien army on the city wall.

With the joint efforts of the three parties, the Zerg Puppies finally rushed to the city wall and engaged in close combat with the alien army.

Behind them, there were endless Zerg Puppies rushing up.

To their left and right, the same black mass of Zerg Puppies rushed to the city wall.

The one-star strength of the Zerg Puppies, coupled with their powerful close combat ability and coordinated combat ability, the star-level soldiers of the alien race's affiliated races really couldn't beat the fierce Zerg Puppies in close combat.

As the Zerg Puppies continued to rush to the city wall, the alien army soon lost control of the city wall.

The Zerg puppies took advantage of the city wall. They used the height of the city wall to jump into the city wall.

Countless Zerg puppies, like a black torrent, rushed into the 996 city of the alien race from all directions.

A more brutal street battle in the city began. The Zerg puppies fully utilized their advantage of not being picky about terrain and environment, and skillfully used various urban environments to attack the alien army.

The three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion climbed up the city wall and began to provide long-range fire support for the Zerg puppies from a high position.

"Boom boom...!"

The huge explosions that occurred from time to time were the Zerg Queen commanding the Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes to attack the Zerg puppies.
